name: Unprepared Sawtooth Flank
summary: Unprepared Sawtooth Flanks are meat taken from crocolisks and snappers in the Swamp of Sorrows. Dar seeks a shipment for Tok'Kar's outpost, where the soldiers can cook it over their fire.

sections.title: Meat for the Outpost
sections.body: At the beach outpost in the Swamp of Sorrows, Tok'Kar's soldiers have little time to gather supplies between guard duty and cooking. Dar asks you to bring eight Unprepared Sawtooth Flanks for their fire. The meat comes from full-grown sawtooths; the young ones are not as tasty.

faq.answer: They are uncooked meat from Sawtooth Crocolisks and Sawtooth Snappers in the Swamp of Sorrows.
Dar asks you to bring the flanks to Tok'Kar, whose soldiers are stationed at an outpost near the beach.
The soldiers have little time to gather supplies while taking guard shifts and cooking. Sawtooth meat gives them fresh food for the fire.
Sawtooth Crocolisks and Sawtooth Snappers in the Swamp of Sorrows provide the meat. The young sawtooths are less tasty than those at full size.

angles.text: Horde soldiers at the Swamp of Sorrows outpost rely on supplies brought from beyond their guard duty. Dar's request helps put fresh meat on their fire.
The outpost soldiers cook sawtooth meat when they can. Dar seeks full-grown flanks for Tok'Kar's fire.
